comment: Images the image tooling runs, each pinned by the digest of its multi-arch index (checked 2026-11-18; base 2026-11-23). Bump them in the deps round; a new base digest is how a Node or Debian security fix reaches the images.

tools.comment: Release binaries of the SBOM tool and the scanner, pinned by sha256 from each release's checksums file; versions at least two weeks old when pinned (Trivy's tags were hijacked in March 2026).
